posts.title: What Does Gravity Actually Look Like?
posts.description: You know how gravity is usually explained with that downwards funnel? A 2D grid, then someone plops a big bowling ball on it, and suddenly it's all marbles spinning into it. That analogy gets shown in every pop-science explainer ever — and for years, it totally threw me off.
